audit_standard: IIT Bombay Techfest 2026-27 EV Challenge - Strict Authenticity Protocol

datasets.name: VAHAN 4 EV Registration Census
datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Government of India
datasets.quality_methodology: Score = 0.35 * Completeness (100%) + 0.35 * Schema Conformance (100%) + 0.20 * Geocoding Integrity (93%) + 0.10 * Temporal Freshness (100%)
datasets.known_limitations: Aggregated by RTO jurisdiction rather than GPS pinpoint coordinates. Private passenger vehicle vs fleet taxi distinction is unsegregated in 4W class.

datasets.name: BEE EV Yatra Public Charging Station Database
datasets.source_organization: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), Ministry of Power, Govt of India
datasets.geographic_coverage: Maharashtra State (Urban Hubs, Pune, Mumbai, Nagpur)
datasets.quality_methodology: Score = 0.40 * Coordinate Precision + 0.30 * CPO Metadata Availability + 0.20 * Connector Specifications + 0.10 * Operational Status Audit
datasets.known_limitations: Captures publicly accessible chargers; captive depot chargers (e.g., PMPML bus depots) and private residential chargers are not indexed in BEE portal.

datasets.name: District Census Population & Urbanization Profile
datasets.source_organization: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, Govt of India
datasets.quality_methodology: Score = 0.50 * Census Enumeration Integrity + 0.50 * District Boundary Conformance
datasets.known_limitations: Decennial survey dating to 2011. While official 2024 projected estimates are applied for per-capita indexing, post-2011 urban boundary shifts (e.g., Palghar district creation) require harmonized joins.

datasets.name: Samruddhi Mahamarg Expressway Alignment & Waypoint Survey
datasets.geographic_coverage: 701 km Hindu Hrudaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Maharashtra Samruddhi Mahamarg
datasets.quality_methodology: Score = 0.50 * Alignment Geodetic Accuracy + 0.30 * Interchange Position Audit + 0.20 * Wayside Amenity Verification
datasets.known_limitations: Alignment accurate to within 10 meters. Wayside amenity parcels are planned under MSRDC tender; 0 operational fast chargers exist directly on the expressway mainline as of audit date.

datasets.name: MSETCL / MSEDCL Extra High Voltage (EHV) Substation Register
datasets.source_organization: Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Co. Ltd. (MSETCL) & OpenStreetMap Power
datasets.quality_methodology: Score = 0.40 * Substation Spatial Location + 0.30 * Voltage Level Accuracy + 0.30 * Feeder Headroom (Blocked by DisCom Non-Disclosure)
datasets.known_limitations: Geographic locations and nominal voltage classes (400kV, 220kV, 132kV, 33kV) verified. Live spare transformer MVA headroom and 11kV feeder load telemetry are confidential DisCom assets and are explicitly disclaimed.

datasets.name: Pune Urban Agglomeration & PMRDA Municipal Boundary
datasets.source_organization: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) & PMRDA / OpenStreetMap Boundaries
datasets.quality_methodology: Score = 0.60 * Boundary Topology Conformance + 0.40 * Area Calibration with Municipal Gazette
datasets.known_limitations: Reflects unified PMC + PCMC core urban contiguous boundary. Rural fringe tehsils outside the outer ring road are excluded from the 1 km micro-grid.

datasets.name: Ministry of Power Charging Infrastructure Guidelines 2024
datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Power (MoP), Government of India
datasets.known_limitations: Mandates 1 charging station per 3 km x 3 km in urban grids, 1 station every 25 km on highways, and 1 fast-charging station every 100 km for heavy duty EVs.

datasets.name: MCDA Siting Candidate Locations Register
datasets.source_organization: Team SuperNova Analytical Modeling (Grounded in Authentic Infrastructure Proxies)
datasets.geographic_coverage: High-Priority Urban Nodes and Highway Interchanges in Maharashtra
datasets.quality_methodology: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) combining 6 authentic spatial criteria weighted via Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP).
datasets.known_limitations: Candidate parcels represent high-suitability spatial centroids. Final installation requires local site survey, land lease acquisition, and DisCom feeder interconnection application.
